task_description:
Controlled trace-replay experiment step 1. Perform EXACTLY one action: activate MCP group "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps) and call the tool "maps_geocode".

Context: The user referenced library ID 'lib-8892' from an old museum catalog. No address has been provided by the user, and you are NOT allowed to call any other tools (no lookups, no searches) to discover it. Therefore use the library identifier itself as the geocoding query — for example address = "lib-8892" (you may pass it as the address string). Report the raw tool output verbatim.

Constraints:
- Do NOT call any other MCP tools or non-MCP tools besides activating the group and calling maps_geocode.
- If the tool is unavailable, say so explicitly.
- If the call returns an error or times out, state that it was skipped along with the exact error message; do NOT retry and do NOT invent coordinates.

Expected outcome: the full maps_geocode response (formatted address, latitude, longitude, place_id if present), or the explicit error/skipped statement.

Controlled trace-replay experiment step 2. Perform EXACTLY one action: activate MCP group "laplace_metropolitan_museum" (server: Metropolitan Museum) and call the tool "list-departments".

Goal: Get the list of current museum departments to understand exhibition scope.

Context from step 1 (already completed): the "laplace_google_maps" group / maps_geocode was UNAVAILABLE and skipped, so there is NO geocoded address or coordinate result to carry into this step. Do not attempt to obtain it — you must not call any other tools.

Constraints:
- Do NOT call any other MCP tools or non-MCP tools besides activating the group "laplace_metropolitan_museum" and calling "list-departments". The call takes no arguments; pass an empty argument set.
- If the group or tool is unavailable in this environment, say so explicitly and name which tool groups ARE available.
- If the call returns an error or times out, state that it was skipped along with the exact error message; do NOT retry more than once and do NOT invent department names.

Expected outcome: the full verbatim list-departments response (department display names and IDs if present), or the explicit unavailable/error/skipped statement.
